title: JAXbounce: A Continuous-Control Pong-Like Benchmark for Active Inference Beyond Low Dimensional Environments
title_zh: 【JAXbounce：一个超越低维环境的主动推理连续控制类Pong基准】

paragraphs.en: 总结：JAXbounce是一个基于JAX的连续控制类Pong基准环境，支持可微并行模拟和多种观测与噪声模型，用于推动主动推理研究超越低维环境。 We introduce JAXbounce, a continuous control pong-like benchmark designed to evaluate active inference beyond discrete, low dimensional environments. JAXbounce combines continuous states and stochastic dynamics in discrete time with flexible and composable observation models that allow representing the environment as a state vector or a pixel grid, corruptible through the rich family of noise models we provide. It is fully differentiable and parallelisable in JAX. We run over 10,000 agent simulations on our environment comparing a baseline deterministic solution, to a state-based active inference agent with Unscented Kalman Filter perception and expected free energy planning, and a pixel based agent whose measurement model is a pretrained neural network encoder. All agents are evaluated across three scenarios of increasing difficulty with eight different noise conditions. Our experiments characterise how performance of continuous state agents scales with planning, planning horizons, observation modalities and knowledge of the noise process, exhibiting preference-oriented behaviour even in the presence of increasing uncertainty. We release JAXbounce as a reproducible benchmark for continuous control active inference research.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：JAXbounce 是一个基于 JAX 的连续控制类 Pong 基准环境，支持可微并行模拟和多种观测与噪声模型，用于推动主动推理研究超越离散低维环境。我们提出 JAXbounce，这是一个连续控制类 Pong 基准环境，旨在将主动推理的评估拓展到离散、低维环境之外。 JAXbounce 将离散时间下的连续状态与随机动力学相结合，并配备灵活可组合的观测模型，既可以将环境表示为状态向量，也可以表示为像素网格，并可通过我们提供的丰富噪声模型家族对其加以污染。 它在 JAX 中是完全可微且可并行化的。 我们在该环境中运行了超过 10,000 次智能体模拟，将一个基线确定性方案，与一个基于状态的主动推理智能体（采用无迹卡尔曼滤波感知和期望自由能规划），以及一个基于像素的智能体（其测量模型是一个预训练的神经网络编码器）进行比较。 所有智能体都在三个难度递增的场景和八种不同的噪声条件下进行评估。 我们的实验刻画了连续状态智能体的性能如何随规划、规划时域、观测模态以及对噪声过程的了解而变化，展现出即使在不确定性不断增加的情况下仍具有偏好导向的行为。 我们发布 JAXbounce 作为可复现的基准，用于连续控制主动推理研究。
